what: Proposed write-failure harness bypasses the real Step 0b abort path
scenario_or_breakage: SKILL.md still instructs the orchestrator to exit 1 immediately when write-run-params.sh fails, before the router-flag recovery block. Case 5 can pass because it calls recovery_merge_if_needed directly, while actual /design write failures still never exercise that recovery.
suggested_fix: Move the recovery merge instruction before the contract-drift abort, or make the harness assert the documented abort and drop the write-failure recovery claim; keep the test aligned with actual Step 0b control flow.
